edges.reason: unlock() authorizes the caller by comparing _previousOwner with msg.sender.
unlock() gate depends on block.timestamp > _lockTime, a timestamp dependency.
lock() computes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, a timestamp dependency.
_transfer anti-bot logic uses block.timestamp - launchTime to flag bots.
transfer/transferFrom feed _msgSender() into _transfer as the from argument.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership enforces _owner == _msgSender().
onlyOwner guards excludeAntibot against arbitrary callers.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendMarketing which performs an external ETH transfer.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendDev which performs an external ETH transfer.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract token balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls setBotFees when sender or recipient is flagged as a bot.
swapAndSendMarketing forwards the computed ETH balance through a low-level call.
swapAndSendDev forwards the computed ETH balance through a low-level call.
The low-level value call to marketingWallet can reenter the transfer flow before state settles.
The low-level value call to devWallet can reenter the transfer flow before state settles.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call controlled during transfer.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity to mint liquidity on the router.
addLiquidity executes an external payable router call during the transfer flow.
deliver() uses unvalidated _msgSender() as the reflection balance sender.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router liquidity deadline.
setDevFee recomputes totalFeesTax from _devFee and other fees with only an upper bound check.

normalization_plan.reason: The time parameter only feeds the onlyOwner lock() timestamp computation and has no independent role.
The tAmount parameter is consumed solely by deliver() reflection accounting.
The tokens parameter scopes only to swapAndSendMarketing and its swap call.
The tokens parameter scopes only to swapAndSendDev and its swap call.
The from parameter is the transfer source threaded into _tokenTransfer inside _transfer.
The to parameter is the transfer destination threaded into _tokenTransfer inside _transfer.
The amount parameter drives anti-whale checks and accounting within _transfer.
The ac parameter is only used to clear the _isBot flag in excludeAntibot.
The local newBalance is the exact value passed to the marketing low-level call.
The local newBalance is the exact value passed to the dev low-level call.
The local contractTokenBalance is computed and spent entirely inside _transfer's swap block.
